resources.string: Three things to know, and then the app is yours.
Your work stays on your phone, in the Joy Creator folder you choose.
No account, no ads, no tracking. Nothing about you is sold or shared.
Something leaves your phone only when you use a feature that needs the internet, like an AI you connect.
